userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for caption focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-78-002 through US-78-012) covering caption segment chapter mapping, tag-based scoring, description chapter parsing, caption coverage gap reporting, retry budget diagnostics, caption cache backward compatibility, caption quality tiered penalty tuning, language fallback chain, caption stage progress granularity, caption timeout adaptive scaling, and caption segment deduplication.

userStories.title: Add chapter_index and chapter_title fields to CaptionSegment
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionSegment dataclass in src/caption/models.py has optional chapter_index (int) and chapter_title (str) fields with defaults (None and '')
CaptionResult.to_dict() serialization includes the new chapter fields when present
CaptionResult deserialization from cache JSON gracefully handles missing chapter fields (backward compat)
A new function map_segments_to_chapters(segments, chapters) in src/caption/models.py assigns chapter_index/title to segments based on timestamp overlap
Unit test verifies segment-to-chapter mapping with overlapping boundaries assigns to chapter with most overlap
userStories.notes: Implemented. Added chapter_index (Optional[int], default None) and chapter_title (str, default '') to CaptionSegment. to_dict() includes chapter fields only when chapter_index is not None. Cache deserialization in cache_models.py gracefully handles missing fields with .get() defaults. Added map_segments_to_chapters() function using greatest-overlap algorithm. 17 tests pass in test_caption_segment_chapters_us78_002.py, 27 existing caption tests pass with no regressions.

userStories.title: Add video tag overlap boost to confidence scoring
acceptanceCriteria: New function apply_tag_overlap_boost in src/matching/scoring.py computes keyword overlap between voiceover segment keywords and video tags
Graduated boost applied: 1 tag match gives +0.02, 2 matches gives +0.04, 3+ matches gives +0.06
confidence_breakdown includes a 'tag_overlap' entry with component, adjustment, and reason fields
Boost is gated by config flag matching.context_enrichment.extract_video_tags (already exists, default true)
Unit test verifies graduated boost values and that zero-overlap produces no adjustment
userStories.notes: Implemented. Added apply_tag_overlap_boost standalone function + MatchScoring method with graduated step function (1->+0.02, 2->+0.04, 3+->+0.06). Integrated as step 9b in apply_all_adjustments with 'tag_overlap' breakdown component. Gated by context_enrichment.extract_video_tags with dict/object config handling. 12 tests pass in test_tag_overlap_boost_us78003.py. No regressions in existing tag_keyword_boost tests.

userStories.title: Parse chapter timestamps from video description text
acceptanceCriteria: New function parse_description_chapters(description_text) in src/caption/models.py returns List[dict] with {title, start_time, end_time} entries
Regex handles common YouTube timestamp formats: '0:00 Title', '00:00 Title', '0:00:00 Title', '[0:00] Title'
Returns empty list when no timestamps found or description is empty
End times are inferred from next chapter start time; last chapter end_time defaults to None
Config flag matching.context_enrichment.parse_description_chapters gates this behavior (already exists, default true)
Unit test covers all 4 timestamp formats plus edge cases (single chapter, no timestamps, malformed input)
userStories.notes: Added parse_description_chapters() to src/caption/models.py with all 4 timestamp formats (M:SS, MM:SS, H:MM:SS, [M:SS]). Bracket format and None end_time for last chapter. caption_fetcher.py delegates to models version. 15 new tests + 9 existing tests pass.

userStories.title: Add caption coverage gap summary to stage output
acceptanceCriteria: Caption stage logs a structured summary after processing each batch: total videos, captioned count, avg coverage ratio, videos with gaps >10s
Summary includes top 3 largest gaps with video_id and gap duration for debugging
CoverageAnalysis (src/caption/models.py lines 443-464) is used as the data source
Summary is logged at INFO level (not DEBUG) so it appears in normal pipeline output
Unit test verifies summary generation with mock CaptionResults having varying coverage ratios
userStories.notes: Added _log_coverage_gap_summary method to CaptionStage. Logs structured summary at INFO level with total_videos, captioned_count, avg_coverage_ratio, videos_with_gaps_over_10s, and top_3_largest_gaps. Uses analyze_caption_coverage from caption/models.py. 5 unit tests in test_caption_coverage_gap_summary.py all pass.

userStories.title: Add retry budget exhaustion diagnostics with actionable suggestions
acceptanceCriteria: When retry budget is exhausted, log message includes: (1) which limit was hit (attempts vs backoff_time), (2) dominant error category, (3) suggested config change
Suggestion is context-aware: RATE_LIMIT errors suggest increasing backoff or enabling VPN, NETWORK errors suggest checking connectivity, TIMEOUT errors suggest increasing timeout
A new method get_exhaustion_diagnostics() on CaptionRetryBudget returns a dict with limit_hit, dominant_error, suggestion fields
Existing exhaustion log at budget check point calls get_exhaustion_diagnostics()
Unit test verifies correct diagnostics for each of the 3 error categories (RATE_LIMIT, NETWORK, TIMEOUT)
userStories.notes: Added get_exhaustion_diagnostics() method with context-aware suggestions for RATE_LIMIT, NETWORK, TIMEOUT, PARSE, UNAVAILABLE errors. Wired into budget_exhausted() logging. 10 new tests, all 334 pass.

userStories.title: Ensure caption cache backward compatibility with new metadata fields
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionResult.from_dict() class method (or deserialization path) handles cache entries missing video_description, video_chapters, video_tags, language_confidence, and fallback_language fields
Missing fields default to their dataclass defaults (empty string, empty list, 1.0, empty string respectively)
A unit test deserializes a legacy cache dict (pre-US-70) without any metadata fields and verifies all defaults are correct
A unit test deserializes a current cache dict with all metadata fields and verifies round-trip fidelity
CaptionSegment deserialization handles missing chapter_index and chapter_title gracefully
userStories.notes: Added video_description, video_chapters, video_tags, language_confidence, fallback_language fields to refactored CachedCaption (cache_models.py). Updated to_dict, from_dict, to_caption_result, from_caption_result. Updated cache.py store(). Added 17 new backward-compat tests including chapter_index/chapter_title on CaptionSegment.

userStories.title: Add configurable thresholds for tiered caption quality penalties
acceptanceCriteria: TieredCaptionPenalties config in src/config/sections/matching.py has individual penalty values as configurable fields instead of hardcoded constants
Config fields: auto_generated_penalty (default -0.05), low_quality_penalty (default -0.08), missing_timing_penalty (default -0.03), max_caption_penalty (default -0.12)
apply_tiered_caption_penalties in src/matching/scoring.py reads from config instead of hardcoded values
config.yaml matching section includes the new tiered penalty fields with comments explaining each
Unit test verifies custom penalty values from config are applied correctly
userStories.notes: All 5/5 criteria verified. 6 tests pass in TestTieredCaptionPenaltiesNestedConfig.

userStories.title: Add caption language fallback chain with priority ordering
acceptanceCriteria: Config option download.caption_first.language_priority accepts a list of language codes in preference order (default: ['en', 'en-US', 'en-GB'])
Caption fetcher tries each language in priority order before falling back to auto-generated captions
When a non-primary language is used, language_confidence on CaptionResult is set to a reduced value (0.8 for second choice, 0.6 for third+)
The fallback_language field on CaptionResult records which language was actually used when it differs from primary
Unit test verifies language priority ordering and confidence reduction for non-primary languages
userStories.notes: Tier: Feature. language_confidence and fallback_language fields exist on CaptionResult (lines 573-575, US-73-012) but the actual language fallback logic in caption_fetcher.py is basic. Many YouTube videos have en-US or en-GB tracks but not plain 'en'. A priority chain reduces unnecessary transcription fallbacks. Files: src/caption_fetcher.py (language selection logic), src/caption/models.py (CaptionResult), src/config/sections/download.py (caption_first config), config.yaml

userStories.title: Add per-video progress tracking to caption stage batch processing
acceptanceCriteria: Caption stage emits progress callbacks with video_index/total_videos ratio during batch processing
Progress includes current video_id and elapsed time for the current video
Slow videos (>30s processing time) trigger a warning log with video_id and elapsed time
Progress is compatible with the existing TTY-aware streaming output (lines 600-800 of caption_stage.py)
Unit test verifies progress callback is invoked with correct video_index for a 3-video batch
userStories.notes: Implemented. Added start_time to fetching progress callback and slow_video (>30s threshold) progress event in batch_processor.py. Added slow_video TTY-aware handler in caption_stage.py on_progress. 6 new tests in test_caption_per_video_progress.py covering: 3-video batch index verification, video_id/elapsed inclusion, slow_video >30s warning, ratio correctness, threshold boundary, and TTY field compatibility. All 77 related tests pass (71 existing + 6 new).

userStories.title: Add adaptive timeout scaling based on retry budget consumption rate
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionRetryBudget tracks consumption rate as attempts_used/elapsed_seconds
When consumption rate exceeds 2x the expected rate (batch_size/timeout_budget), subsequent backoff delays are increased by 1.5x
A new method get_adaptive_backoff_multiplier() returns the current multiplier (1.0 when normal, up to 3.0 max)
The multiplier resets to 1.0 after 60 seconds of no new errors
Unit test verifies multiplier increases when consumption rate exceeds threshold and resets after cooldown
userStories.notes: Tier: Resilience. CaptionRetryBudget has max_backoff_time_seconds (default 300s) but doesn't adapt the pace of retries based on how fast the budget is being consumed. Rapid consumption often means YouTube is actively rate-limiting, so slowing down saves budget and is more likely to succeed. Files: src/caption/retry_budget.py (CaptionRetryBudget class), tests/test_caption*.py

userStories.title: Add caption segment deduplication for overlapping timestamp ranges
acceptanceCriteria: New function deduplicate_segments(segments) in src/caption/models.py detects and merges segments with >80% timestamp overlap from the same source_file
Merged segments keep the longer text and the union of the timestamp range
Deduplication is called after caption parsing, before segments are stored in CaptionResult
Dedup count is logged at DEBUG level when duplicates are found
Unit test verifies: (1) identical segments merged, (2) partial overlap >80% merged, (3) partial overlap <80% kept separate, (4) different source_files never merged
userStories.notes: Tier: Data quality. Some YouTube caption tracks (especially auto-generated or multi-format) produce overlapping segments for the same time range. These duplicates inflate segment counts and can cause double-matching. The overlap threshold of 80% catches near-duplicates while preserving intentional segment splits. Files: src/caption/models.py (CaptionSegment class, new function), src/caption_fetcher.py (post-parse integration point), tests/test_caption*.py
